label: prf:alpha-em-shift-multiplicative-chain
title: Proof of alpha em shift multiplicative chain
html:
Proof. Proof of alpha em shift multiplicative chain

Proof

The identity composes two named identities:

  1. prop:em-coupling-projection establishes the bare combinatorial form:

      \alpha_{EM}^{-1} \;=\; q \cdot [9]_q \cdot [10]_q.

    We derive this from the antisymmetric eigenvalue -q^{-1} of the R-matrix and the q-deformed crossing numbers of the force-carrier generators T_{2,9} and T_{3,5}. By prop:force-carrier-bring-uniqueness, this basis consists exactly of the genus-4 saturating torus-knot set on \Sigma_4.

  2. prop:alpha-shift-torus-knot establishes the closed-form identity:

      \alpha_{\mathrm{shift}}(T_{p,k}) \;=\; k(p-1)
  \qquad (\gcd(p, k) = 1)

    on the all-anti-symmetric channel V_{(1^p)}. We specialise at (p, k) \in \{(2, 9), (3, 5)\}:

      \alpha_{\mathrm{shift}}(T_{2,9}) \;=\; 9 \cdot 1 \;=\; 9,
  \qquad
  \alpha_{\mathrm{shift}}(T_{3,5}) \;=\; 5 \cdot 2 \;=\; 10.

Substituting these values into the bare formula yields the stated identity exactly:

  \alpha_{EM}^{-1}
  \;=\; q \cdot [9]_q \cdot [10]_q
  \;=\; q \cdot \bigl[\alpha_{\mathrm{shift}}(T_{2,9})\bigr]_q
              \cdot \bigl[\alpha_{\mathrm{shift}}(T_{3,5})\bigr]_q.
  \qquad \square

Numerical verification

The composition holds exactly at the symbolic level. Numerical re-evaluation at q_0 (alpha-em-shift-multiplicative-chain.witness.json, mpmath 50-dps) reads \alpha_{\mathrm{shift}}(T_{2,9}) and \alpha_{\mathrm{shift}}(T_{3,5}) from the upstream witness alpha-shift-torus.witness.json. It compares the chain expression to the bare expression:

  |\,\text{chain} - \text{bare}\,| \;=\; 0

identically to mpmath precision, with both equalling \alpha_{EM}^{-1}(q_0) \approx 136.823. The gap |\,\text{chain} - \text{CODATA}\,| \approx 0.213 is the \mathcal{O}(10^{-3}) precision gap inherited from prop:em-coupling-projection. This refactoring leaves it unchanged. Closing this gap requires conj:e-hartree-categorical-derivation and higher-order C_5-invariant corrections.

All 3 assertions in the witness pass.
